material.acceptance_criteria: 1) rust/crates/wasip3 guest answers mod-load with an err line (existing). 2) native host in rust/crates/wasip3/src/main.rs sends mod-load and checks the reply is exactly the refusal. 3) ci.yml wasip3 job greps the printed line 'wasip3 mod-load refused' . 4) live local run through gm exec prints that line.
material.description: Owner decision (gm-orch-3-9-r2): the wasip3 guest stays sim-only. Mods run in the native host because vendored lua-src 547.0.0 has no wasi build arm (its build script panics off linux/bsd/apple/windows/emscripten). The refusal already exists: rust/crates/wasip3/src/lib.rs:65 returns 'this guest is built without the mod runtime' for mod-load. The edit is the CI assertion only: the native host sends mod-load and the wasip3 CI job greps for the refusal. Supersedes the wasip2 framing (wasip2 removed in 9ad18d27).
material.resolution: wasip3 guest is sim-only by design; mod-load refusal is asserted in CI on the green tip.
material.subject: wasip3 guest stays sim-only: mod-load is refused with an explicit error, and CI asserts the refusal
material.witness: verifier gm-orch-6-v1-wasip2 at c003bda (green 24/24, run 39070142959): 'sim as wasip3 guest on nightly' log contains 'wasip3 mod-load refused reason=no mod runtime'.
material.witness_plan: Local: build guest for wasm32-wasip3 and run oscraft_wasip3 on map.osdt; expect 'wasip3 mod-load refused reason=no mod runtime' and 'wasip3 tick ok'. CI: wasip3 job green on the pushed sha.
